name: RF-16
description: A load/store machine with a register file: eight registers R0-R7 named as operands, so one ADD Rd, Rs, one MOV and one LDR work with any of them, where RISC-16 needs an opcode per register. The cost is ticks: selecting each register is a transfer of its own.

programs.name: Hello, world on the LCD
programs.description: A print subroutine walking the string with LDR R0, R1

programs.name: Fibonacci on the LCD
programs.description: RISC-16's program with register operands; the print routine keeps to R4-R7
